mentions.name: Simplescraper
mentions.description: Simplescraper is a web scraping tool that extracts instant structured data from websites without writing HTML parsing code. Launched on Hacker News and grown into a business, it is expanding its surface area for AI agents with MCP support, a screenshots API, and an experimental x402 payment protocol integration.
mentions.problem: Extracting structured data from websites traditionally requires writing HTML parsing code.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Data extraction: https://simplescraper.io

A project that I launched on HN that became a business. Simplescraper rode the no-code wave of a few years back ('instant structured data without parsing html').

Now working on increasing the surface area for AI agents: MCP support, screenshots API, and (experimentally) x402[1]
